title: Can US Stocks Defy September Headwinds? | Presented by CME Group
description:
The S&P 500 remains less than 2% below its record high despite rising bond yields, elevated energy prices and ongoing trade tensions. But September is historically the index’s weakest month, and those pressures show little sign of easing. Presented by @cmegroup
